hed: Crisp fall Saturday on Table Rock — bright skies and perfect lake conditions
deck: Saturday, October 17 delivers clear skies, a high near 63°F and crisp low around 42°F with no rain in the forecast. This is prime fall weather for first-time visitors — comfortable for lake time, a matinee show, or strolling the Branson Landing fountain after dusk.
